correctness.rationale: All 40,320 strict vertex orderings produce a self-contained 1,060-face complex with exact checks on 65,536 candidate incidence subsets. A deterministic 527-pair matching is checked against every one of the 4,064 actual Hasse incidences, and the resulting reversed digraph is acyclic by complete topological sorting. The only critical cells are one vertex and five three-cells, proving the integral wedge homotopy type, without extrapolation. Additional finite-field homology checks corroborate.

value.rationale: The first pure/full divergence is a natural sharp small-parameter boundary: four tetrahedral facets added at the eight-cycle change the known pure homotopy information. The actual full complex admits a perfect five-sphere Morse reduction, resolving the integral homotopy and attaching-map ambiguity that published Betti data alone does not settle.
